tool.help:
RADAR-PD Interactive provides one shared setup experience for Full RADAR-PD and Rapid Hypothesis Mode. It can upload local files, reuse datasets in the current Galaxy history, resolve SNS IPTS inputs, submit the existing batch Analyze tool, show progress, recover earlier runs, render interactive results, and expose reproducible artifacts.
Recovered runs can reopen their published GPX checkpoints directly in the hosted GSAS-II desktop.
Use the User guide button in the application header to open the screenshot walkthrough and example configuration downloads in a separate tab.
For optional reviewed refinement recipes, add your personal ORNL Illumine key to the ORNL Illumine credential group in NDIP. Galaxy injects the selected credential into your NOVA session; regular RADAR-PD analysis does not require it.
For optional magnetic model exploration, select your personal Bilbao credential group. Galaxy injects its key as BCS_API_KEY into NOVA for authenticated subgroup discovery. Candidate catalogs are then passed to the scientific worker without the key. The headless launcher accepts --with-bilbao together with --with-illumine.
Credential selection belongs to the exact Galaxy tool version. Check it after an upgrade and start a new session to apply it. Headless launches must include the selected credentials_context; the packaged radar_pd_nova.launch helper sends vault references without reading the Illumine secret.
The scientific calculation runs as a normal Galaxy job. Closing this interactive session does not cancel that job or remove its history outputs.
